name: Pink Daisy
fullName: Oipuloh Pink Daisy Crochet Flowers Bouquet
tagline: A little sunshine that never wilts.
alt: Oipuloh Pink Daisy crochet flower bouquet with a gift bag and greeting card
description: Bright pink daisy blooms are hand-crocheted from soft cotton yarn, with a sunny yellow center and a few smaller accent flowers tucked between them. The bouquet arrives fully assembled — not a DIY kit — and is wrapped in blush and butter-yellow paper.

Set it on a desk, shelf, or nightstand and it stays just as it is: no water, no trimming, no dropped petals. A gift bag and greeting card are included, so it is ready to give for birthdays, anniversaries, thank-yous, or a quiet just-because.

name: Yellow Lily & Pink
fullName: Oipuloh Yellow Lily & Pink Crochet Flowers Bouquet
alt: Oipuloh Yellow Lily and Pink crochet flower bouquet with gift bag and card
description: A yellow lily sits among soft pink blooms, all hand-crocheted from cotton yarn. The mix feels sunlit and romantic — a little garden gathered into one finished bouquet.
About nine crochet blooms, wrapped by hand and finished with a ribbon. It needs no water or sunlight, and it will not drop petals on the shelf. Gift bag and greeting card included.

name: Sun Daisy
fullName: Oipuloh Sun Daisy Crochet Flowers Bouquet
alt: Oipuloh Sun Daisy crochet flower bouquet with white bellflowers
description: A yellow sun daisy is paired with small white bellflowers for a country-garden feel. Every bloom is crocheted from soft cotton yarn and assembled by hand.
With about twelve crochet blooms, this is one of the fuller styles in the collection. It arrives ready to display or give, with a gift bag and greeting card included.

name: Yellow Rose
fullName: Oipuloh Yellow Rose Crochet Flowers Bouquet
tagline: Warm, golden, and made to keep.
alt: Oipuloh Yellow Rose crochet flower bouquet with cream buds
description: A golden yellow rose with soft cream buds, hand-crocheted from cotton yarn. Warm, cozy, and a little old-fashioned in the best way.
About fourteen crochet blooms make this the fullest bouquet in the collection. It is a gentle choice for Mother's Day, get-well wishes, birthdays, friendship gifts, or a housewarming.

name: Pink Peony
fullName: Oipuloh Pink Peony Crochet Flowers Bouquet
tagline: Soft layers that stay in bloom.
alt: Oipuloh Pink Peony crochet flower bouquet with sage green wrapping
description: A layered pink peony with sage green wrapping, crocheted petal by petal from soft cotton yarn. The sage wrap gives it a softer, more botanical look.
About eight crochet blooms, finished by hand and ready to display. It works for Mother's Day, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, and housewarmings — and it never needs water.

name: Pink Roselle
fullName: Oipuloh Pink Roselle Crochet Flowers Bouquet
tagline: A garden flower with a little wildness.
alt: Oipuloh Pink Roselle crochet flower bouquet with soft yellow accents
description: Pink roselle-style blooms with soft yellow accents, hand-crocheted from cotton yarn. The shape is full and slightly wild, like a garden flower that kept growing.
About nine crochet blooms, wrapped and ribboned by hand. A gift bag and greeting card are included for Valentine's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, or a housewarming.

name: Pink Rose & Tulip
fullName: Oipuloh Pink Rose & Tulip Crochet Flowers Bouquet
tagline: Roses and tulips, in one small bouquet.
alt: Oipuloh Pink Rose and Tulip crochet flower bouquet
description: Pink rose-shaped blooms are mixed with tulip-inspired flowers, all crocheted from soft cotton yarn. Romantic without being formal — roses and tulips in one small bouquet.
About five crochet blooms, arranged by hand and finished with a ribbon. It is a natural fit for Valentine's Day, anniversaries, birthdays, weddings, and romantic home décor.
